security_concerns: Inherited DOCKER_CONTEXT could override a Unix DOCKER_HOST while the verifier skipped context inspection, violating local-only authorization.
suggestions: Check visible DOM text before solo screenshots, scan all artifacts and purge earlier artifacts on a privacy failure; binary matching is not OCR.
Assert observed left+fire samples for two/three bots and neutral-steering fire for one bot.
Add process-level inert solo help/invalid-authorization tests with no Playwright dependency.
disposition: Preserved initial blocked review. Separate fixer implemented endpoint validation/pinning and the suggested harness hardening, with RED/GREEN Node regression evidence. Fresh independent review is required before commit; the initial review is not approval.
boundary: The actual archived local browser runs used explicit non-remote Podman, not the affected Docker selection path. This finding concerns verification-tool authorization, not an identified deployed-game vulnerability.
